about.metaDescription: Get to know __SITE__, your portal for K-Drama, K-Pop and Korean culture in Portuguese.
about.title: About __SITE__
about.p1: __SITE__ is a Brazilian portal dedicated to Korean pop culture — dramas, films, K-Pop, artists and groups — all in Portuguese, made for the Brazilian fandom.
about.p2: Our goal is to be the reference for Hallyu content in Brazil: a complete catalog of productions with detailed fact sheets, artist and group profiles, editorial articles and guides for people just starting out in the Korean universe.
about.find1: A catalog of Korean dramas and films with ratings and technical information
about.find2: Profiles of K-Pop artists and groups
about.find4: News and updates on Hallyu releases, charts, tours and trends
about.transparency: Our coverage combines news, guides, reviews and profiles. To understand how we classify content, correct information and use editorial tools, see our <padroes>editorial standards</padroes>, <etica>code of ethics</etica> and <correcoes>corrections policy</correcoes>.

ethics.title: Code of Ethics
ethics.intro: __SITE__ covers Korean pop culture with a focus on information, context and usefulness for readers in Portuguese. Our commitment is to keep fact, analysis, opinion and sponsored material separate.
ethics.independence: Story selection, headlines and editorial recommendations must serve the reader's interest. When there is a partnership, advertising, affiliate link or commercial support, it must be clearly identified.
ethics.accuracy1: We do not publish sensitive accusations without editorial caution and a verifiable basis.
ethics.accuracy2: We do not present rumor as confirmed fact.
ethics.accuracy3: We do not use a headline or description that promises information absent from the text.
ethics.accuracy4: We avoid speculation about private life, health or appearance without clear public relevance.
ethics.conflicts: Sponsored content, advertorials, commercial links or any relationship that could influence coverage must be disclosed to the reader within the content itself.

standards.metaDescription: __SITE__ editorial standards: news, guides, reviews, sources, corrections and use of AI.
standards.title: Editorial Standards
standards.intro: __SITE__ publishes news, analysis, guides, reviews and profiles about K-pop, K-drama and Korean culture. Each format has a different editorial role.
standards.news: News stories must open with the main fact, identify relevant names, dates, works, companies and numbers, and separate confirmed information from editorial reading. News must not use a promotional tone or hide the factual origin of the subject.
standards.guides: Evergreen content can take a more analytical approach, but it still has to keep accuracy, context and clarity. Reviews must indicate when there is an editorial assessment. Profiles must avoid speculation and prioritize verifiable data.
standards.sources: Whenever possible, we prefer primary sources, official statements, platform data, artist pages, companies, charts and verifiable public information. When a piece of information is still developing, the text must avoid definitive conclusions.
standards.ai: __SITE__ may use artificial intelligence tools to support research, story planning, editing, preliminary translation, drafting and editorial checks. Published content must go through editorial review before publication. AI must not be used to invent sources, quotes, numbers, statements or facts.
standards.corrections: Corrections follow our <correcoes>Corrections Policy</correcoes>. Requests can be sent through the <contato>Contact</contato> page.

corrections.metaDescription: How __SITE__ corrects information, updates stories and records editorial changes.
corrections.title: Corrections Policy
corrections.intro: __SITE__ corrects factual errors, names, dates, titles, numbers, links and contextual information whenever it identifies an inconsistency or receives a valid correction request.
corrections.request: Send the URL of the story, the passage that needs review and the source that supports the correction through our <contato>contact form</contato>.
corrections.how1: Simple spelling, romanization or formatting errors may be fixed directly.
corrections.how2: Relevant factual errors are checked against available sources before the change.
corrections.how3: When a correction changes the understanding of the story, the text must indicate that it was updated.
corrections.how4: We do not change publication dates just to simulate freshness.
corrections.updates: News stories may be updated when new verifiable information emerges. Guides, profiles and reviews may be reviewed periodically to keep data and links useful to the reader.
